test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘TRIGONOMETRY’ is written as ‘YRTEMOTRIGON’, ‘ACCELERATION’ is written as ‘NOITARACCELE’. How will ‘APPRECIATION’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Shift reverse of second half of word in front of First half of word.**

1. ‘TRIGONOMETRY’ : ‘YRTEMOTRIGON’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87f0722d2e1bba2486f895383dbed46751085dd4a6039d684ed94e70b494ee5d.png] 

2. ‘ACCELERATION’ : ‘NOITARACCELE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/172760bccbc2f73520ad3cb07661f1e54be6182600411f17be9ab6beeda577ae.png] 

Similarly,

‘APPRECIATION’ : ‘NOITAIAPPREC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0155410b97dda7d68b0810cfcad49e57dc713dd3767ce044ad487570e64e403.png] 

Hence, **'****NOITAIAPPREC'** is the correct answer.
